title: Rivian Roamer Releases | Rivian Roamer
text:
March 11, 2026
 Daily Activity Phantom Drain
 You can now view your daily phantom drain from the activity view.Note: Phantom Drain includes energy use while the vehicle is stationary and excludes pre-conditioning, charging and gear guard use.
 March 2, 2026
 Efficiency Trends
 Now you can get an idea of your efficiency trends over time. Compare which driver is more efficient and even see how towing impacts your efficiency! I take no responsibility for spousal disputes.
 February 24, 2026
 View your Achievements
 Easily view where you rank across all leaderboards in one place on the new Achievements page of Rivian Roamer. This is also the new landing page of some fun features actively in development.
 February 22, 2026
 Refreshed dashboard UI
 The vehicle dashboard has been redesigned with clearer navigation and a streamlined layout. On mobile, the dashboard now feels like a native app, access features faster, and spend less time hunting for what you need.
 February 19, 2026
 Cold Weather Range Impact
 Along with Rivian's 2026.03 software update you can now see the range impact the cold weather is having on your vehicle from your dashboard.
 February 16, 2026
 Trips: Turn Sessions into Adventures
 Your Rivian doesn't just take you on drives — it takes you on trips. Now Roamer Plus tracks them that way.Group your drive and charge sessions into a single trip and get the full picture: total distance, time behind the wheel, energy used, fuel saved, efficiency across the entire journey, and elevation profile — all in one view.Name your trips, see every session broken down day by day, and trace your route on the map. Whether it's a weekend getaway or a cross-country road trip, you'll know exactly how your Rivian performed.
 February 16, 2026
 Improvements to Drive Session searching and filtering
 Now you can filter your drive sessions by your wheel and tire configurations.
As well as sort by new elevation-related data. Sort by most elevation gain/loss, net elevation gain/loss and highest/lowest points.
 Get the most out of your Rivian
 Every drive mapped, every charge explained. See what Roamer Plus can do for you.
